sourceBindings.text: Use the testing laboratory's extraction and measurement methods, units, crop-specific interpretation and regional guidance. Phosphorus 12 ppm, for example, can have different meaning under Bray and Olsen extraction. A single soil nitrogen number is a time-specific clue; crop requirement, prior inputs, nitrogen credits and timing matter. The classroom N meal and P/K pantry analogy helps remember this difference but cannot set a rate.

units.delivery: Explain calmly and naturally to agricultural vocational learners in clear English. Read only the supplied connected passage with natural pauses. Preserve all negations, conditions, scene-safety restrictions and limits of training. Do not add medical advice, diagnoses, character voices, an introduction, music or an extra summary.
